description: The Coil Live rulebook, versioned: the cycle order, exits first, how a stop is derived, how a position is sized on its stop, the day-lane rhythm and the fail-closed rules an agent trades against. It updates on the next read when the rules improve. Coil Live is a subscription with a 7-day free trial; subscribers connect the Coil Live connector and sign in, and this read returns live data.
name: get_live_rules
